channel.title: Azerbaijan Press Agency (APA) - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Azerbaijan Press Agency (APA) (en.apa.az)

item.title: President Ilham Aliyev congratulates Greek President on national holiday
item.description: President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev has congratulated His Excellency Constantine An

item.title: Iran denies reports of talks with US – MFA
item.description: Iran has denied reports that it is holding negotiations with the United States, Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Ismail Baghaei said in an interview with India Today, APA reports

item.title: Drone entering Estonian airspace from Russia hits Auvere power station chimney
item.description: A drone which entered Estonian territory from Russian airspace hit a chimney at the Auvere power station in Ida-Viru County early on Wednesday morning, ERR reports

item.title: IEA ready to release additional oil reserves to market
item.description: The International Energy Agency is ready to release additional oil reserves to the market if necessary, IEA head Fatih Birol said during his visit to Tokyo in response to Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s request regarding “the release of additional oil in case of a prolonged war in the Middle East,” APA reports

item.title: Gold prices approach $4,600 again
item.description: Gold prices in global commodity markets have approached $4,600, APA-Economics reports

item.title: Turkish minister: 620 billion liras needed for energy budget if war continues
item.description: Türkiye’s Minister of Energy and Natural Resources Alparslan Bayraktar said an additional 620 billion liras would be required for the energy budget if the US–Israel–Iran war continues, APA reports

item.title: EU delays proposal to permanently ban Russian oil
item.description: The European Union on Tuesday postponed the unveiling of a law that would permanently ban Russian oil imports, coming amid supply disruptions caused by the war in the Middle East, The Moscow Times reports

item.title: US–Iran talks may be held in Islamabad over the weekend
item.description: Talks between the United States and Iran may take place in Islamabad over the weekend, Director General of the International Atomic Energy Agency Rafael Grossi said in an interview with Corriere della Sera, APA reports

item.title: Israel’s army strikes two missile production sites in Tehran
item.description: The Israeli Air Force (IAF) recently attacked two key missile production sites in Tehran, the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) said in a report, TASS reports

item.title: President Ilham Aliyev attends opening of Absheron Battery Energy Storage Center
item.description: President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev attended the opening of the “Absheron” Battery Energy Storage Center of AzerEnerji Open Joint Stock Company on March 25, APA reports
